about_short_description.short_description: Farawlaya.com showcases designers intimate and home wear apparel for women of all shapes and sizes.

product.name: Lingerie Sets
product.description: Apparel sets including bras, panties, garter belts, and teddies designed for women of various sizes.

product.name: Bodystockings
product.description: One-piece stretch garments made from mesh, lace, or fishnet materials designed to cover the torso and limbs.

product.name: Corsets
product.description: Structured garments designed to shape and support the torso, often featuring boning and lace details.

product.name: Sleepwear and Pajamas
product.description: Comfortable nightwear sets including pajamas, nightgowns, and robes made from soft fabrics.

product.name: Costumes and Themed Apparel
product.description: Outfits designed for role-playing, parties, or special occasions, including themed lingerie and costumes.

product.name: Beachwear and Burkinis
product.description: Swimwear and modest beachwear sets including full-body burkinis with skirts, pants, and swim caps.
